Terra Nova River watershed predictions

HydroATLAS data that can be used in gravel models to estimate gravel with the proper size for salmon spawning. Includes example predictions of gravel size.
Click on a reach to see the data for each segment. Link to download shapefile is below map.


Click here to download the Terra Nova River HydroATLAS data shapefile
